title: eludite.workspace.search output
description: The rows of the Workspace window whose name matches the query, in the tree's order (ancestors that only lead to a match are not listed), at most 500. With an empty query, or with no workspace open, `rows` is empty.

query.description: The query the answer is for (the box's text).

path.description: The file, project file, solution or folder on disk, when the row stands for one (a folder of a project has none).

name.description: The row's text as the Workspace window shows it (`Eludite.Host (net10.0)`, `HostRpcTarget.cs`).

total.description: How many rows match, also beyond the 500 listed.

truncated.description: True when `total` is more than the rows listed.
